title: Characterizing the Separability Gap in Prior-Data Fitted Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.14989v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) are transformers pretrained on simulated datasets to approximate Bayesian posterior predictive distributions. Standard PFN theory assumes a separable task prior, under which the feature distribution and the mechanism generating labels from features are independent. We show that common PFN priors are non-separable, even in simple settings. Consequently, standard pretraining targets a predictive distribution based on a task posterior updated using both the labeled context and the query features. We characterize its difference from the predictive based on the context posterior alone and show that this difference vanishes under posterior concentration. Under misspecification (i.e., when the true joint distribution lies outside the prior's support), however, prior non-separability can favor better feature fit at the expense of conditional label fit. translated_title: 刻画先验数据拟合网络中的可分性差距
translated_abstract: 先验数据拟合网络是在模拟数据集上预训练的Transformer模型，用于近似贝叶斯后验预测分布。标准的PFN理论假设任务先验是可分的，即特征分布与从特征生成标签的机制相互独立。我们证明，即使在简单的设置下，常见的PFN先验也是不可分的。因此，标准的预训练目标所针对的是一个基于任务后验的预测分布，而该后验是同时利用带标签的上下文数据和查询特征进行更新的。我们刻画了这一预测分布与仅基于上下文后验得到的预测分布之间的差异，并证明在后验集中条件下这一差异会消失。然而，在模型误设的情况下（即真实联合分布位于先验支撑集之外），先验的不可分性可能导致更好的特征拟合，但以牺牲条件标签拟合为代价。我们以特征归因为例说明了这一后果……
tldr: 本文证明常见的PFN先验即使在简单设定下也是不可分的，刻画了由此产生的预测分布与标准理论之间的可分性差距，并揭示在模型误设时不可分先验会偏向更好的特征拟合而牺牲条件标签拟合。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that common PFN priors are non-separable even in simple settings, characterizes the resulting separability gap between the pretrained predictive distribution and standard PFN theory, and shows that under misspecification prior non-separability favors better feature fit at the expense of conditional label fit.
